**1.017: Transform a transcript into an email, a to-do list or minutes, and your clipboard comes back after a paste.**

- **Transform… (experimental):** on the Transcription tab, rewrite a transcript with one of 206 ready-made prompts (a business or casual email, a to-do list, meeting minutes, a post, data formats and more), filtered by type and style or searched. Edit any prompt to make it your own; your version is kept and the original can be restored. The transcript is never changed: copy the result or save it as a version beside it.
- Transform needs the transform model, an optional download in Models → Utilities (Qwen3 4B Instruct, 2.5 GB), run offline on the processor; a transform takes tens of seconds on a laptop. Not yet tried end to end on a user's computer.
- **Fixed (Linux):** after a paste, the transcript stayed on the clipboard, so the next Ctrl+V pasted it again. Your previous clipboard is now put back. With Output → Clipboard on, the transcript is still copied on purpose.
- Beta: Ubuntu 26.04 .deb. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
